script_package.title: Pipe Wars: Roadman Showdown
script_package.description: Two roadmen, one pipe, pure brainrot chaos. Who gets the puff? Watch the ultimate showdown!
script_package.call_to_action: Tap to see who wins the pipe!
script_package.spoken_script:
Character A: "Yo, fam, what's that you're clutching? On my life, I clocked that first, bruv."
Character B: "Nah, moving mad, innit? This pipe's mine, I had it in my hand, you just saw it."
Character A: "Saw it? I felt the vibes, man! My withdrawals are kicking in, you're vexed if you think I'm letting this slide."
Character B: "Vexed? You're the one moving like a fiend! I'll buss your head open for this, fam, try me."
Character A: "Try you? I'll finesse that pipe right out your hand, watch me. You're washed, bruv."
Character B: "Washed? I'll put you in a headlock, you little sponge! This is my pipe, and that's on everything!"
Character A: "You wanna go, then? Let's settle this right here, right now, no cap."
Character B: "Bring it on, then, you little opp. You ain't getting a single puff, on my mum's life!"
